versions.body:
A prestigious address should not cost a prestigious rent.

Harbor Street address — from $29 a month. Your mail is scanned and forwarded. Call answering is included on the Standard plan.

Standard — $29/month. Address, mail scanning, and a phone greeting.
Plus — $79/month. Everything in Standard, plus a meeting room you can book.
Studio — $149/month. A desk in the Dock Road rooms, two days a week.

You will probably never need the meeting room. That is the point.

18 Harbor Street is our flagship virtual address. Mail is received there, scanned, and sent on. Several firms already use it, and the front door looks the way a front door should.

Dock Road has the rooms. If you need a table, a kettle, and a door that closes, book a room there.

Both are in Port Calder. Neither requires you to keep a plant.
